research_question: What are the critical gaps in discovery, trust, compatibility, and commerce primitives for non-developer service providers entering the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) economy, and how can a 'Google My Business for agents' platform address these gaps compared to existing developer-centric solutions?

phases.name: Landscape
phases.objective: Survey the current state of A2A discovery, trust, compatibility, and commerce mechanisms, identifying key players, standards, and non-developer onboarding solutions
sub_questions: What registries (Smithery, Glama) and standards (MCP, .well-known/agent-card.json, DIDs) exist for machine-readable discovery and reputation, and how do agents query them at runtime?
What platforms currently allow non-developers to publish agentic services, and how are payment primitives (Stripe MPP, Google AP2, x402) currently adopted in the market?
phases.evidence_priorities: Official docs for MCP registries, A2A Agent Cards, trust protocols (AgentSeal, Enkrypt AI), payment rails (Stripe MPP, Google AP2, x402), market data on A2A adoption, competitor analyses (Mintlify vs Shopify-like platforms)
phases.stop_condition: Complete when 3+ distinct approaches/architectures/tools are identified for each of the 4 primitives (discovery, trust, compatibility, commerce)

phases.name: Mechanics
phases.objective: How do agents evaluate counterparties, match protocols, and execute commercial A2A transactions in production environments?
sub_questions: How do agents programmatically verify trust (verifiable credentials, attestations) and protocol compatibility (MCP, function calling, auth) before transacting?
What are the structural mechanics of real production A2A2A chains (e.g., insurance claim -> adjuster -> payment), including attribution and programmable spend limits?
phases.evidence_priorities: Production code examples of agent handoffs, A2A transaction flows, protocol compatibility scorecards, real implementation of Coinbase x402 or Stripe MPP, GitHub repos with MCP server setups
phases.stop_condition: Complete when 2+ real implementation examples with architectural breakdowns or code patterns are found per primitive

phases.name: Failure Modes
phases.objective: What breaks in A2A interactions regarding trust degradation, stale discovery, incompatible protocols, and failed commerce?
sub_questions: How do MCP registries handle stale or malicious listings, and what are the known failure modes in cross-agent auth (OAuth 2.1, mTLS)?
What causes trust degradation across multi-hop A2A2A chains, and how are disputes/refunds handled in current agent payment rails?
phases.evidence_priorities: Post-mortems on multi-agent chain failures, incident reports on malicious MCP listings, known vulnerabilities in agentic payment flows, CVEs related to cross-agent trust, cost blowup horror stories
phases.stop_condition: Complete when 5+ distinct failure modes across the 4 primitives are documented with their respective mitigations

phases.name: Contrarian
phases.objective: Why might a non-developer A2A publishing platform fail, and what alternative architectures could obsolete this approach?
sub_questions: What are the strongest arguments that agents will self-build connections at runtime, bypass platforms by reading docs directly, or that major foundational models will absorb these primitives?
phases.evidence_priorities: Analyses of protocol churn (e.g., breaking revisions), industry predictions of monolithic AI integration (Anthropic/Google/Apple absorbing primitives), examples of agents successfully routing around platforms
phases.stop_condition: Complete when 2+ substantive counter-arguments with concrete evidence or trend data are found

search_strategy: machine-readable agent reputation mechanisms DID AgentSeal
MCP registries Smithery Glama interop querying at runtime
Stripe MPP Shared Payment Tokens 2026 agent economy
Coinbase x402 HTTP 402 USDC micropayments for AI
Google AP2 Mandates September 2025 AI agents
multi-hop A2A2A chain production examples attribution
Shopify Agentic Storefronts vs Speakeasy FastMCP
MCP protocol breaking changes churn analysis
exclusion_criteria: Consumer-facing AI agent user interfaces (e.g., ChatGPT UI features)
General LLM benchmarking or foundation model training details
Developer-only frameworks that do not have a path for non-developer onboarding (unless used for direct contrast)
Purely theoretical academic papers without production or open-source implementation
Web3/Crypto projects unrelated to explicit A2A micropayments (exclude general DeFi/NFTs)

required_output_schema.per_finding_format: Each finding must include: claim, supporting evidence, confidence (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), source URLs, and counter-evidence if any
required_output_schema.per_source_format: Each source must include: URL, title, credibility (1-5), recency, type (primary/secondary/opinion)

openai_instructions: Focus on logical deduction, fault-tree analysis, and edge case mapping. Map the state-space of A2A interactions across the 4 primitives. Analyze the logical gaps where existing developer tools fail non-developers. Construct analytical models for why trust degrades over multi-hop chains and outline the exact state transitions required for programmatic dispute/refund flows.
gemini_instructions: Prioritize massive data ingestion and broad synthesis. Crawl and extract documentation from Smithery, Glama, Stripe MPP, Coinbase x402, and emerging MCP standards. Pull specific code examples of A2A handoffs and auth methods. Gather broad adoption statistics, traffic data, and disclosed revenue from A2A platforms from 2025-2026. Compare APIs of developer vs non-developer onboarding tools.
claude_instructions: Focus on nuanced qualitative analysis, iterative web searching, and source verification. Rigorously investigate the contrarian angle: evaluate the threat of foundation models absorbing A2A primitives, the impact of protocol churn, and the viability of agents self-building connections at runtime. Cross-reference claims about real production multi-hop chains and assess the qualitative trade-offs of centralized vs decentralized discovery.
